prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Houston for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” orthodontist for everyone — the right provider depends on your location, budget, age, complexity of the case, and personal preferences (e.g., invisibility of treatment, speed). I can help you find a great fit. To start, here’s how to choose and where to look.

What to look for
- Board certification and training: prefer an orthodontist (not a general dentist) who is a member of the American Association of Orthodontists (AAO). Board certification by the American Board of Orthodontics (ABO) is a strong plus.  
- Experience with your treatment of interest: ask how many Invisalign cases vs. braces cases they treat, and whether they handle complex cases with clear aligners. Some offices are Invisalign “Diamond/Platinum” providers (many cases), which can indicate experience with aligners — but it’s not the only quality measure.  
- Technology and planning: look for digital scanning (iTero or similar), 3D treatment planning, or CBCT if needed for complex cases.  
- Before/after photos and references: ask to see cases similar to yours and, if possible, talk to current or recent patients.  
- Communication and convenience: location, office hours, emergency care, payment plans and whether your insurance is accepted.  
- Follow-up and retention: what retainer protocol do they use and is follow-up included?

Questions to ask at a consultation
- Are you a board-certified orthodontist? Will you personally do my treatment?  
- Do you have experience treating cases like mine with braces and/or Invisalign? What would you recommend and why?  
- What is the expected treatment time and total cost? What’s included? Are retainers included?  
- What technologies do you use (digital scans, 3D planning)?  
- How often are visits and how do you handle emergencies?  
- Can I see before/after photos of similar cases and read patient reviews?

Where to find reputable providers
- AAO “Find an Orthodontist” tool (aaoinfo.org)  
- Invisalign provider locator on Invisalign.com  
- Local review sites: Google reviews, Healthgrades, RealSelf, Yelp (read many reviews and look for patterns)  
- Ask your general dentist for recommendations

Typical costs (very general)
- Braces: roughly $3,000–$7,000 depending on type and complexity.  
- Invisalign/clear aligners: roughly $3,000–$8,000 depending on case complexity. Insurance and promotions can change final cost.

If you want, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Houston  
- Whether this is for a child, teen, or adult  
- Any preferences (Invisalign vs invisible braces, budget, insurance)

I can then pull together a short list of highly rated orthodontists near you and highlight things to compare for each.
